title: Rural Health Transformation Depends on People, Not Programs
summary: Learn how Papa builds trust among rural and isolated communities to improve engagement, close gaps, and support better health.
body_markdown: To truly transform health outcomes in rural America, leaders need a way to make care reachable in the real world. States can build the frameworks necessary to transform care, and hospitals and health systems can stand up the services needed to deliver it, but extending that care into people’s daily lives requires a human layer that many organizations can’t scale on their own. This in-person support builds the trust members need to engage, stay engaged, and stay healthy.
